## Activity

During February 2026, East City Eye Clinic completed 188 captures. Activity proceeded as expected, with session lists managed in accordance with planned clinic arrangements. The available sessions were delivered as scheduled, apart from routine leave. This did not prevent the service from completing the reported activity for the month. The capture total provides the overall volume of images submitted for assessment and supports monitoring of clinic throughput.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for assessment. Of the 188 captures, 2 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 1.1 per cent. The ungradable images should continue to be reviewed through routine quality assurance processes so that any recurring issues with image acquisition, patient positioning, or equipment use can be identified and addressed. Overall, the number of images that could not be graded remained limited in relation to the total activity.

## Grading

There were 70 referable results during February 2026. The median grading lag was 1 day, indicating that results were generally processed promptly. Continued monitoring of grading timeliness and referral outcomes will support consistent service performance and help identify any changes requiring operational attention.
